name: Alice
status: new (an exact slice of the 600-cell: cell-first, in a gap (cut at its midpoint); one of the four 144-corner slices; not found as a solid in the sources checked, #63)
scale_note: frame: the 600-cell of #63 (circumradius 2, edge sqrt5 - 1), cut by the 3-space at height 1/4 along the cell-first direction d (atlas row W49, the midpoint of its gap). Coordinates: Im(conj(d) p) for each point p of the cut, the slice turned into R^3 and scaled by |d|; divide lengths by |d| for the polytope's own scale.

source.path: research branch (k-research): studies/2026-10-27-white-queen-600/scripts/atlas600.py (the cut); checked against data/atlas600.json row W49

centre.kind: origin of the frame (= the corner centroid)

unit_volume.note: x -> centre + s (x - centre), s = V^(-1/3) with V the exact volume above; s is symbolic and the corners are decimals (15 places, as elsewhere). Same corner order and faces as above; volume 1.
